# Mirage SDK for Mirror's Edge: generated by mirage_sdkgen (tools/sdkgen), copied from tools/sdkgen/static. Don't edit,
# regenerate (memenu sdk).
#
#   add_subdirectory(sdk)
#   target_link_libraries(my_target PRIVATE mirage::sdk)
#   #include "sdk/SDK.hpp"
#
# The headers are packed (#pragma pack(1)) with every member at the engine's offset; the sources hold the function
# wrappers and a static_assert for every offset and size, so a wrong layout fails the build.

file(GLOB _mirage_sdk_sources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.cpp)
add_library(mirage_sdk STATIC ${_mirage_sdk_sources})
add_library(mirage::sdk ALIAS mirage_sdk)
target_include_directories(mirage_sdk PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
target_compile_features(mirage_sdk PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(mirage_sdk PRIVATE /bigobj /W4)
endif()
